== Description ==
Hey there, friends and neighbors!

Our winter update is out!

Watch this new episode of Dairy News, where Camilla, Hay Day’s game designer, takes you through all the new and improved features in Hay Day. Like the new Sanctuary Valley, the new Lucky Bonus mini game, and so much more!

Grab a blanket, get cozy and enjoy the new update video!
